text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"……It is defeat. A total, helpless 
defeat."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"As a Saint, having overcome numerous 
trials, I could truly feel the power 
gradually swelling within me."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
With me being like this, unable to do 
anything... How could... How could this 
happen...?
choice_data_list: D-Desire, please don't be so down...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I shall embrace it! The mercy 
bestowed by this grand will!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: You think so too, don't you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Being granted trials of this magnitude is 
proof that I can become a true Saint."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And once we overcome this, the other world 
will be that much closer!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
O heavens, I offer my deepest gratitude 
for bestowing upon me such a great trial.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Saint Red Desire. I swear here and now to 
overcome this hardship and reach 'that 
distant land.'"

text_block_list.text: Yes. After all, I am a saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Failing a trial is no sin. Yielding to 
failure and giving up is the true sin."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"A Saint would never commit such a sin. 
Until I reach 'that place,' I will rise 
again and again!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My! What a splendid idea. After all, this 
is not something easy enough to overcome 
without a plan.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I simply cannot contain my 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The dazzling view that awaits beyond this 
trial.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"If I can see that with you, nothing could 
make me happier!"
